listening.en: The scenery team needed skilled pairs of hands to repair the folding panels. Several volunteers could carry materials, but only two had practised the joinery; we asked about their time before putting their names on the repair rota.
listening.zh: 佈景小組需要有實務技巧的人手修理摺板。幾位義工能搬材料，但只有兩位練過木工接合；把名字放上維修輪值表前，我們先問了他們的時間。
listening.promptZh: 小組怎樣分清人數、技能及安排？

options.en: Carrying help was available, while the joinery skill and the skilled volunteers’ time needed separate attention.
options.zh: 有人可搬運，但接合技能及有技巧者的時間需要分開處理。

options.en: Every volunteer had already completed the same joinery training and accepted a repair shift.
options.zh: 每位義工都已完成相同接合訓練，也接受了維修更次。

options.en: The team put everyone on the repair rota solely because they could carry materials.
options.zh: 小組只因大家能搬材料，就把每人列入維修表。

options.en: The two trained volunteers had already accepted the complete repair rota.
options.zh: 兩位受訓義工都已接受整張維修輪值表。

listening.explanationZh: 搬運能力、接合技巧及能否值班是不同資料；只有兩位練過，也仍需確認時間。

reply.promptEn: Why was the number of volunteers not the only staffing question?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼義工人數不是唯一的人手問題？

options.en: The repairs needed skilled pairs of hands, and carrying materials did not establish the joinery skill.
options.zh: 修理需要有實務技巧的人手，能搬材料卻不等於有接合技巧。

options.en: Only two people had practised the specific work the folding panels required.
options.zh: 只有兩人練過摺板需要的特定工作。

options.en: The team also needed to know whether the trained people had time to take a shift.
options.zh: 小組也需要知道受訓者是否有時間值班。

options.en: Headcount alone would not show who could carry out the repair or agree to do it.
options.zh: 單憑人數，不會顯示誰能修理及願意答應。

reply.explanationZh: 四句各自指出人數以外的具體需要，不把願意搬運當成已具每項技能。

scene.promptZh: 十人新報名幫忙，但表格沒問經驗，也未見任何作品；負責人想寫技術人手已全部到位。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: Ten names do not yet establish skilled pairs of hands for the particular work; the relevant experience still needs checking.
options.zh: 十個名字還不能確定，有適合特定工作的熟練人手；相關經驗仍待核對。

options.en: The list records ten people who have all demonstrated the required technique.
options.zh: 名單記錄了十位都已展示所需技巧的人。

options.en: The account says every volunteer has accepted the same technical duty and time.
options.zh: 敘述說，每位義工都已接受相同技術職務及時間。

scene.explanationZh: 報名可支持有人有興趣，但表格沒有經驗資料，不能把姓名數目轉成已確認技能及排班。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能只從「The team has skilled pairs of hands」推論？

options.en: 團隊有具實務技巧的人。
每人都已答應新增的周末更次。
可以再說明他們具備哪一種技巧。

contrast.explanationZh: 技能與已接受新的時間安排不同；周末能否參與仍須另外詢問。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「兩位會做，就直接寫他們整周負責吧？」還沒有問時間。哪句最好？

options.en: We have skilled pairs of hands, but we still need to ask what time they can offer before assigning the repair week.
options.zh: 我們有熟練人手，但安排整周維修前，仍要先問他們能提供甚麼時間。

options.en: I would use their experience as confirmation that they can cover every requested day.
options.zh: 我會把經驗當成確認，說他們可以負責每個要求的日子。

options.en: I would ask the carrying volunteers to repair the panels first, assuming their practical skills transfer without another check.
options.zh: 我會先請搬運義工修理摺板，假定他們的實務技能能直接轉用，不必再核對。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可以承認技能，同時向本人確認時間；兩項資料不需互相代替或取消。

speaking.en: We need skilled pairs of hands for this part, so let us ask about relevant experience and availability before dividing the work.
speaking.zh: 這部分需要熟練人手，所以分工前，我們先問相關經驗及可用時間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把技能及時間分別確認。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：Mina在木偶修補活動中，仔細縫好撕裂的接縫，還向新手示範怎樣讓兩邊布料對齊。你要在活動結語直接向她致謝，具體肯定修補及解釋，不把一次幫忙說成已答應永久教學。用一至兩句英文寫致謝。

examples.en: Mina gave us more than a skilled pair of hands: she repaired the torn seam and explained how to keep the fabric aligned. Thank you, Mina, for making that careful technique something the beginners could also learn.
examples.zh: Mina不只是提供有技巧的人手：她修好撕裂的接縫，也解釋怎樣保持布料對齊。Mina，謝謝你讓新手也有機會學到那項細緻技巧。

examples.en: We were grateful for a skilled pair of hands when Mina repaired the puppet, and equally grateful that she explained each step. Thank you for sharing both your practical skill and a clear demonstration with our new members.
examples.zh: Mina修補木偶時，我們很感謝她提供有技巧的幫忙，也同樣感謝她解釋每一步。謝謝你向新成員分享實務技巧及清楚示範。

writing.selfCheckZh: 直接感謝Mina，具體肯定修補、布料對齊及解釋技巧的貢獻，不把技巧當成永久教學的義務。

takeaways.en: The project found skilled pairs of hands when two former makers offered to demonstrate their repair techniques.
takeaways.zh: 兩位以前的製作者願意示範維修技巧時，項目找到了熟練人手。

takeaways.en: A skilled pair of hands helped us finish the delicate detail, while the rest of the group prepared the materials.

listening.en: Experienced sound operators were in short supply. Two could help, but some simultaneous festival performances had no operator; the organiser asked about new times instead of calling the rota complete.
listening.zh: 有經驗的音響操作人員短缺。兩人能幫忙，但部分同時舉行的節慶演出仍無人操作；統籌人詢問新時間，沒有說輪值表已完整。
listening.promptZh: 短缺在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Some experienced help was available, but not enough for the simultaneous performances.
options.zh: 有部分有經驗的人可幫忙，但不足以應付同時演出。

options.en: No experienced sound operator had offered to help.
options.zh: 沒有有經驗的音響操作人員提出幫忙。

options.en: The organiser had filled every performance slot before asking about the times.
options.zh: 統籌人詢問時間前，已填妥每場演出的人手。

options.en: The groups had already agreed to cancel the whole festival.
options.zh: 各組已同意取消整個學生節。

listening.explanationZh: 兩人可幫忙，仍有同時場次未覆蓋，所以是不足，不是完全無人或全部已排妥。

reply.promptEn: Why did the organiser ask about changing performance times?
reply.promptZh: 統籌人為甚麼詢問更改演出時間？

options.en: Experienced operators were in short supply, leaving some simultaneous performances uncovered.
options.zh: 有經驗的操作人員短缺，部分同時演出仍無人負責。

options.en: The available help did not cover all the performances at their current times.
options.zh: 現有人手，無法覆蓋現行時間的全部演出。

options.en: Adjusting times was an option to discuss while the staffing gap remained.
options.zh: 人手缺口仍在時，調整時間是一個可商量的選項。

options.en: The rota was not complete, even though two experienced people could help.
options.zh: 即使兩位有經驗的人能幫忙，輪值表仍未完整。

reply.explanationZh: 四句各自以實際未覆蓋的場次解釋查問，不把商量改時說成已取消節慶。

scene.promptZh: 倉庫有很多大信封，但這次需要的小信封只剩兩個，不足以寄出五份資料。有人只看總箱數就說沒有短缺。哪句最準確？

options.en: Small envelopes are in short supply for this mailing, even if other sizes are plentiful.
options.zh: 即使其他尺寸充足，這次寄件所需的小信封仍供應不足。

options.en: The plentiful large envelopes establish that five small ones are available.
options.zh: 大量大信封，確定了有五個小信封可用。

options.en: The account describes a shortage of every envelope size in the warehouse.
options.zh: 敘述描述，倉庫每種尺寸的信封都短缺。

scene.explanationZh: 需求指定小信封；其他尺寸的總量不能代替合適種類，也不表示每一種都缺。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能只由「The material is in short supply」推論？

options.en: 相對某項需要，這種材料可用數量不足。
倉庫已一件也沒有這種材料。
可以再問是哪個地點、種類或時段不足。

contrast.explanationZh: 不足不等於零，也沒有自行交代永久供應狀態。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「兩人能幫忙，就寫人手已夠吧？」仍有同時演出未分配操作員。哪句最好？

options.en: Operators are still in short supply at those times; the two offers help, but they do not fill the remaining gaps.
options.zh: 那些時段仍缺操作人員；兩份協助有用，但未補齊剩餘缺口。

options.en: I would use two accepted offers as confirmation that every simultaneous performance is covered.
options.zh: 我會把兩份已答應的協助，當成每場同時演出都有人負責的確認。

options.en: I assumed short supply meant that no operator had offered to help at all.
options.zh: 我以為人手短缺，表示完全沒有操作人員提出幫忙。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認已有部分協助，也準確保留仍不足的時段，不把部分變全部或把部分抹去。

speaking.en: The right-sized clips are in short supply, so we should check which groups actually need them before promising a set to everyone.
speaking.zh: 合適尺寸的夾子不足，所以向每組承諾一套前，應先查哪些組實際需要。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把種類及實際需求說清楚。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們共用的展板夾子只夠部分作品，大組還未核對各自需要，朋友想先把剩餘夾子全留給自己一組。你要在群組請大家先報需要的數量及時段，再商量共用；不要聲稱完全沒有夾子。用一至兩句英文寫實際請求。

examples.en: Display clips are in short supply, so could each group say how many it needs and when before we reserve the remainder for one team? Let us agree a shared plan based on the actual displays rather than assume the first request takes everything.
examples.zh: 展板夾子不足，所以把剩餘全留給一組前，各組可先說需要多少及甚麼時段嗎？我們按實際作品商量共用，不假定最先要求便可拿全部。

examples.en: As clips are in short supply, please send your required number and display time before we allocate what is left. Some are available, and I suggest checking everyone’s needs so we can discuss sharing rather than declare the cupboard empty.
examples.zh: 夾子不足，分配餘下物品前，請先傳所需數量及展示時段；仍有一些可用，我建議先查大家需要，再討論共用，不說櫃子已空。

glossary.en: how many it needs and when

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出先核對需求再商量的程序，具體詢問數量及時段，保留仍有部分可用的事實，不擅自把全部留給一組。

takeaways.en: Suitable storage boxes were in short supply, although the cupboard held plenty of smaller containers.
takeaways.zh: 雖然櫃子有很多較小容器，合適的存放箱仍不足。

takeaways.en: Trained helpers were in short supply that morning, so the team asked which activities could wait.
takeaways.zh: 那早上受訓助手不足，所以團隊問哪些活動可以等一等。

brief.meaningEn: Actions or a process intended to reduce the amount spent by an organisation or on a service.
brief.meaningZh: 組織或服務為減少支出而採取的行動或過程。
brief.grammar: cost-cutting is uncountable; cost-cutting measures/a cost-cutting plan are attributive uses. A plan has an intended saving, not a guaranteed realised result.
brief.register: Common compound noun and attributive modifier, not a fixed idiom. Job or pay reductions are possible contextual measures, not part of the word’s necessary meaning.
brief.boundaryZh: 削減成本不必等於裁員或減薪，也不自動證明質素提高或降低；要看具體措施及結果。
brief.misconceptionZh: 分清擬議、已實行及實際省下的費用，也不要把單次低帳單直接當成已知原因。
brief.outcomeZh: 能準確描述一項成本措施及待驗證結果，而不替不同角色假定影響。

sources.sentence: Cost-cutting can hold pay down.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page155, table1, row12; unknown locators remain null.

listening.en: The club’s cost-cutting plan combines print orders to reduce repeated delivery charges. No new bill has arrived yet, so we described the intended saving rather than announce that spending had already fallen or anyone’s pay had changed.
listening.zh: 社團的削減成本計劃把印刷訂單合併，想減少重複送貨費。新帳單還未到，所以我們只說明預期節省，沒有宣布支出已跌或任何人的薪酬已改。
listening.promptZh: 計劃內容與已確認結果有甚麼不同？

options.en: Orders would be combined to reduce charges, but the actual saving was not yet known.
options.zh: 訂單會合併以減費，但實際節省仍未知。

options.en: A new bill had confirmed the exact reduction before the plan was described.
options.zh: 描述計劃前，新帳單已確認確切減幅。

options.en: The club had announced a pay reduction for everyone involved.
options.zh: 社團已宣布所有參與者減薪。

options.en: The plan separated each order to increase the number of delivery charges.
options.zh: 計劃把每張訂單分開，增加送貨收費次數。

listening.explanationZh: 合併訂單是具體擬議措施；帳單未到，不能把預期寫成已實現，也沒有薪酬變動資料。

reply.promptEn: Why did you avoid announcing a realised saving yet?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼暫不宣布已實際節省？

options.en: The cost-cutting plan had an aim, but the new bill had not arrived to show the result.
options.zh: 削減成本計劃有目標，但新帳單還未到，無法顯示結果。

options.en: Combining orders was intended to lower charges, not evidence of the final amount itself.
options.zh: 合併訂單的目的是減費，不是最後金額本身的證據。

options.en: We needed the actual charge before describing how much spending had fallen.
options.zh: 我們需要實際收費，才描述支出減了多少。

options.en: The proposed measure and its measured outcome were still separate stages.
options.zh: 擬議措施與量度結果，仍是兩個不同階段。

reply.explanationZh: 四句各自回答結果未明的原因，不否認計劃有節省目的。

scene.promptZh: 活動取消後，一張電費單比平常低；段落沒有說有人採取節省措施。作者想把減幅全歸於新成本政策。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The lower bill does not by itself establish a cost-cutting policy; the cancelled activity is relevant context and the cause needs checking.
options.zh: 較低帳單本身不確定有削減成本政策；活動取消是相關背景，原因仍須核對。

options.en: The account explicitly reports a new policy that reduced electricity use while all activities continued unchanged.
options.zh: 敘述明確報告，一項新政策在活動全不變下減少了用電。

options.en: The lower total establishes that the electricity rate per unit has fallen.
options.zh: 較低總額確定了，每單位電價已下降。

scene.explanationZh: 數字較低與特定政策或單位價格造成的減幅不同；需要先核對取消活動等背景及實際原因。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能只由「They introduced cost-cutting measures」推論？

options.en: 他們採取了旨在減少支出的措施。
兩位員工已因此被解僱。
可以再問措施內容及實際影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 成本措施可以有不同形式，不能單憑名稱補上特定裁員事件。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「削減成本，公告就一定要寫減薪吧？」計劃只涉及合併訂單。哪句最好？

options.en: Cost-cutting here concerns delivery charges; we should describe that measure rather than add an unsupported pay change.
options.zh: 這裏削減成本關乎送貨費；我們應描述該措施，不加入沒有資料的薪酬改變。

options.en: I would use the general label as enough evidence that everyone’s pay was reduced.
options.zh: 我會把一般名稱當成足夠證據，說每人的薪酬已減。

options.en: I thought the word applied only to pay reductions, so combining delivery orders would not count.
options.zh: 我以為這字只適用於減薪，所以合併送貨訂單不算。

dialogue.explanationZh: 按具體措施描述，既不補上減薪，也不因沒有減薪就否定減少費用的目的。

speaking.en: Before describing the cost-cutting result, I want to distinguish the proposed measure from the saving shown by the actual bill.
speaking.zh: 描述削減成本的結果前，我想把擬議措施與實際帳單顯示的節省分開。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清目的、措施及已知結果。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你是學生劇團司庫，寫演出後的實際帳目摘要。上次六套戲服的租用帳單是180元，這次重用六套舊戲服，修補帳單是60元；其他項目尚未比較，也未問演員穿着感受。用一至兩句英文報告這個已記錄的服裝支出變化，不宣稱全場成本或演員經驗都已改善。

examples.en: Cost-cutting through costume reuse brought the recorded costume bill down from 180 to 60 dollars. That is a saving in this item; we have not yet compared the other costs or asked the actors about comfort.
examples.zh: 重用戲服這項削減成本的做法，讓已記錄的服裝帳單由180元降至60元。這是這個項目的節省；我們尚未比較其他成本，也未問演員穿着是否舒適。

examples.en: The costume-reuse measure was part of our cost-cutting, with a 60-dollar repair bill compared with the previous 180-dollar hire bill for six costumes. The accounts show that limited change, while the other costs and the actors’ experience still need a separate review.
examples.zh: 重用戲服是我們削減成本的一部分：六套戲服這次的修補帳單是60元，上次租用帳單則是180元。帳目顯示這個有限範圍的變化，其他成本及演員體驗仍需另外檢討。

writing.selfCheckZh: 寫已確認帳目的實際摘要，限定在六套戲服的支出比較；不把單項節省擴成全部成本已下降或穿着體驗已改善。

takeaways.en: The cost-cutting exercise combined two deliveries, while the team checked whether the new timing still met users’ needs.
takeaways.zh: 削減成本安排把兩次送貨合併，團隊也核對新時間是否仍符合使用者需要。

takeaways.en: She asked what the cost-cutting measures involved before repeating a claim that jobs had already been lost.
takeaways.zh: 轉述已有職位流失的說法前，她先問削減成本措施包括甚麼。

brief.meaningEn: Pay may stay at roughly the same level rather than increase, with the modal marking uncertainty.
brief.meaningZh: 工資可能大致維持原來水平，而沒有增加；情態動詞表示仍有不確定性。
brief.grammar: wages may remain flat; wages remained flat reports a past outcome; wages have remained flat uses the perfect. Flat describes the level, while may describes possibility, not confirmation.
brief.register: A natural wage-plus-flat-level construction, not a fixed guarantee or a judgement of workers’ skill. The lesson uses fictional reported figures, not pay advice.
brief.boundaryZh: 維持不變不等於降至零，也不直接說明原因、努力或購買力；may不能譯成已確定發生。
brief.misconceptionZh: 把可能、已知結果及原因分清楚，也不從未加薪就直接推斷未有訓練或沒有貢獻。
brief.outcomeZh: 能忠於數字及語氣描述薪酬資訊，不加上未證實的原因或個人評價。

sources.sentence: Without training, wages may remain flat.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page155, table1, row13; unknown locators remain null.

listening.en: The report said wages may remain flat next term, not that a decision had been confirmed. We kept the word may in the summary and asked when the updated figures would be available rather than publish a definite outcome.
listening.zh: 報告說下學期工資可能不變，不是說決定已確認。我們在摘要保留「可能」，並問何時會有更新數字，沒有公布確定結果。
listening.promptZh: 摘要怎樣保留報告的確定程度？

options.en: It retained the possibility and sought updated figures instead of stating a confirmed outcome.
options.zh: 它保留可能性並詢問更新數字，沒有說成已確認結果。

options.en: It changed the forecast into a decision that had already been officially confirmed.
options.zh: 它把預測改成已正式確認的決定。

options.en: It reported a confirmed wage increase smaller than the previous term’s rise.
options.zh: 它報告了已確認加薪，只是增幅比上學期小。

options.en: It removed the uncertainty after receiving the final figures that the report had requested.
options.zh: 它收到報告所要求的最後數字後，才刪去不確定語氣。

listening.explanationZh: may仍在，更新數字仍待取得，所以不是已確認結果，也不能把不變改成較小加幅。

reply.promptEn: Why did you keep may in the summary?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼在摘要保留may？

options.en: Wages may remain flat was a possibility in the report, not a confirmed decision.
options.zh: 工資可能不變，是報告中的可能性，不是已確認決定。

options.en: The updated figures were still unavailable, so a definite outcome would go beyond the information.
options.zh: 更新數字還未有，寫成確定結果會超出資料。

options.en: We needed to preserve the report’s uncertainty rather than strengthen its claim.
options.zh: 我們需要保留報告的不確定程度，不加強說法。

options.en: The summary should not turn a forecast into an announcement that the decision is final.
options.zh: 摘要不應把預測變成最後決定的公告。

reply.explanationZh: 四句各自說明保留情態語氣的理由，不從flat自行補出薪酬成因。

scene.promptZh: 表中本月及上月的同一項時薪都是100，沒有談購買力或員工評估。有人把flat譯成「工資已被減少」。哪句最準確？

options.en: The stated wages remained flat at the same hourly amount; the table does not report a cut or explain purchasing power.
options.zh: 所列工資維持相同時薪，沒有報告減薪，也沒有解釋購買力。

options.en: The table records a lower hourly wage this month than last month.
options.zh: 表格記錄，本月時薪比上月低。

options.en: The unchanged amount establishes that the employer judged every worker’s performance negatively.
options.zh: 金額不變，確定了僱主對每位員工表現都作負面評價。

scene.explanationZh: 相同數字支持金額沒變，不是減少；原因、評價及購買力都需要其他資料。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最忠於「Wages may remain flat next year」的語氣？

options.en: 明年工資已確定維持不變。
明年工資有可能維持不變。
明年工資可能仍會增加，只是增幅比以前慢。

contrast.explanationZh: may表示可能，remain flat表示維持同一水平，不是已確定，也不是仍然上升但升得較慢。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「可能不加薪，就寫員工沒有進步吧？」報告沒有評估員工，也未交代原因。哪句最好？

options.en: Wages may remain flat, but that forecast does not establish a judgement about the workers’ progress or the cause.
options.zh: 工資可能不變，但那項預測沒有確定對員工進步的評價或成因。

options.en: I took the warning to mean the report had already checked why pay might not rise.
options.zh: 我把提醒理解成，報告已核對薪酬可能不增加的原因。

options.en: I thought not announcing a definite outcome meant there was no useful information to report yet.
options.zh: 我以為不宣布確定結果，表示暫時完全沒有有用資料可報告。

dialogue.explanationZh: 薪酬預測沒有交代成因或員工評估；仍可準確報告可能性，不需要把未確定當成完全沒資料。

speaking.en: If wages remain flat, we still need separate evidence about why, rather than infer a cause from the unchanged figure alone.
speaking.zh: 即使工資不變，我們仍需要另外的成因證據，不能單靠相同數字推斷原因。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清數字變化與原因的證據。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你整理一份虛構人物訪談，筆記只確認她的時薪沒有增加，卻說她最近每周工作時數增加；總收入未核對。編輯想寫「她整周收到的錢也完全不變」。用一至兩句英文給編輯實際更正建議，保留時薪資料，並請先問清有薪時數及每周總額。

examples.en: Her hourly wages have remained flat, but that does not establish unchanged weekly earnings when her hours have increased. Could we ask about the paid hours and weekly total before writing that comparison?
examples.zh: 她的時薪維持不變，但工作時數增加時，這不能確定每周收入也不變；寫那個比較前，我們可先問有薪時數及每周總額嗎？

examples.en: Please specify that her hourly wages remained flat rather than say her total pay stayed the same. The notes mention longer hours, so we need to check the paid hours and weekly amount before describing her overall earnings.
examples.zh: 請明確說她的時薪不變，不要說總薪酬也相同；筆記提到工作時間增加，所以描述整體收入前，我們需要核對有薪時數及每周金額。

writing.selfCheckZh: 保留已確認的時薪不變，指出有薪時數及每周金額仍待核對，不把單一比率當成已知總額，也不自行計算未交代的收入。

takeaways.en: The published figures showed that wages remained flat, while the report left the reasons for a separate discussion.
takeaways.zh: 已公布數字顯示工資不變，報告把原因留待另行討論。

takeaways.en: The note warned that wages might remain flat, so she kept that uncertainty in her account of the forecast.
takeaways.zh: 便條提醒工資可能不變，所以她敘述預測時保留那份不確定。

lessons.titleZh: 並非讓每一方同樣受惠

brief.meaningEn: Not bring the same degree of benefit to everyone, using boats as an image for different people or groups.
brief.meaningZh: 以不同船隻比作不同人或群體，表達好處未必令每一方同等受惠。
brief.grammar: may/will not lift every boat equally; the negative targets equal distribution, not necessarily benefit itself. May keeps the claim as a possibility.
brief.register: A variation of the familiar rising-tide/boats image, not a literal boating instruction or proof that nobody benefits. The context must identify the groups and the benefit.
brief.boundaryZh: 受惠程度不同，不等於沒有人受惠，也不一定表示某方受損；要看各組實際資料。
brief.misconceptionZh: 分清機會、已取得的成果及改善幅度，不把共同擁有工具當成每人都得到相同幫助。
brief.outcomeZh: 能準確比較不同群體的效果，並提出了解需要的下一步，不替未觀察者保證結果。

sources.sentence: New technology may not lift every boat equally.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page156, table1, row2; unknown locators remain null.

listening.en: The new search tool may not lift every boat equally. Experienced users can try it at once, while newcomers still need an introduction; we planned to hear from both groups before describing how much it had helped.
listening.zh: 新的搜尋工具未必讓每一方同樣受惠。有經驗的人可立刻試用，新手仍需介紹；我們計劃先聽兩組，再描述幫助有多大。
listening.promptZh: 為甚麼暫不假定兩組得到相同好處？

options.en: The groups begin with different support needs, and outcomes have not yet been compared.
options.zh: 兩組開始時有不同支援需要，結果還未比較。

options.en: Both groups have already reported identical measured gains.
options.zh: 兩組都已報告完全相同的量度改善。

options.en: Measured results already show that newcomers gained less than experienced users.
options.zh: 量度結果已顯示，新手得到的改善少於有經驗者。

options.en: The organisers decided to hear only from experienced users and exclude newcomers’ feedback.
options.zh: 統籌人決定只聽有經驗者，排除新手回應。

listening.explanationZh: 兩組有不同準備及支援需要，但結果尚未比較；不能先宣稱效果已相同，也不能把可能不同寫成已有量度證據。

reply.promptEn: Why did you want feedback from both groups before describing the benefit?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼想先聽兩組，再描述好處？

options.en: The tool may not lift every boat equally, since newcomers and experienced users need different starting support.
options.zh: 新手與有經驗者起初需要不同支援，所以工具未必讓每一方同樣受惠。

options.en: One group can begin immediately while the other still needs an introduction.
options.zh: 一組可立即開始，另一組仍需介紹。

options.en: The effect for experienced users alone would not establish the effect for newcomers.
options.zh: 只有有經驗者的效果，不足以確定新手的效果。

options.en: We had not yet compared the actual outcomes across the two groups.
options.zh: 我們還未比較兩組的實際結果。

reply.explanationZh: 四句各自說明比較需要，不把不同起點直接寫成已證實的結果。

scene.promptZh: 試行中兩組都完成更多任務，一組平均多兩項，另一組多六項。評論把「並非同等受惠」寫成「沒人有任何改善」。哪句最準確？

options.en: The tool did not lift every boat equally, but both groups improved by different amounts.
options.zh: 工具沒有讓每一方同等受惠，但兩組都改善了，只是幅度不同。

options.en: The figures show no improvement in either group.
options.zh: 數字顯示，兩組都沒有改善。

options.en: The two groups gained exactly the same number of completed tasks.
options.zh: 兩組增加的完成任務數完全相同。

scene.explanationZh: 不相等的兩項及六項都屬增加；不平等並不等於零改善。

contrast.promptZh: 「It may not lift every boat equally」本身最不能確定哪一項？

options.en: 說話者對同等受惠有所保留。
每個群體都已被證明完全沒有好處。
可以進一步查不同群體的支援及結果。

contrast.explanationZh: 這句保留的是相同程度及確定性，不是宣告每方都無益。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「工具大家都有，就直接寫效果完全相同吧？」你們還未聽新手意見。哪句最好？

options.en: Having the tool may not lift every boat equally; let us hear what newcomers need before claiming the same result for everyone.
options.zh: 有工具未必讓每一方同等受惠；我們先聽新手需要，再聲稱每人效果相同。

options.en: I would use shared access alone as proof of equal improvement.
options.zh: 我會只用共同取得工具，作為改善相同的證據。

options.en: I assumed the introduction had already been given to every user, so I expected both groups to begin from the same position.
options.zh: 我假定每位使用者都已聽過介紹，所以預期兩組起點相同。

dialogue.explanationZh: 取得工具與實際受惠不同；差異值得了解，不必誇成效果相同或全無作用。

speaking.en: The change may not lift every boat equally, so we need to ask whose experience is missing from the first positive reports.
speaking.zh: 改變未必讓每一方同等受惠，所以需要問，最初正面報告漏掉了誰的經驗。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把受惠比較連到缺少的證據。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校打算延長排練室晚間開放，但有些同學必須趕較早的回程巴士，不能使用新增時段。你想保留晚間選項，也請籌委先問是否有人需要一段較早的共用時段，不直接替職員承諾加班。用一至兩句英文寫實際提議。

examples.en: A later closing time may not lift every boat equally, because some students must leave for an earlier bus. Could we keep the evening option and ask whether an earlier shared slot is needed before requesting any further staffing?
examples.zh: 延遲關門未必讓每一方同等受惠，因為有些同學必須趕較早的車；我們可保留晚間選項，也先問是否需要較早的共用時段，再要求額外人手嗎？

examples.en: The extra late session may not lift every boat equally, even if it helps students who can stay. I suggest asking about an earlier slot for those with an earlier journey home, then discussing what staffing is possible rather than promising it now.
examples.zh: 新增較晚時段即使幫到能留下的學生，也未必讓每一方同等受惠；我建議先問較早回家者是否需要早些的時段，再討論可有甚麼人手，不現在就承諾。

writing.selfCheckZh: 保留新增時段的部分好處，也指出不能留下者的具體限制，提出先問需求再商量人手，不否定所有好處或代職員承諾。

takeaways.en: The new timetable may not lift every boat equally, since some members still cannot attend the earlier start.
takeaways.zh: 新時間表未必讓每一方同樣受惠，因為有些會員仍不能提早到場。

takeaways.en: Extra practice did not lift every boat equally; both groups improved, but their progress was different.
takeaways.zh: 額外練習沒有讓每一方同等受惠；兩組都改善，但進展不同。

brief.meaningEn: A difference between people, groups or measures that is becoming larger over time.
brief.meaningZh: 人、群體或數據之間的差別，隨時間越來越大。
brief.grammar: a widening gap between A and B; widening requires comparison over time, not only a single large difference. A gap can widen while both quantities rise.
brief.register: A common figurative difference/trend collocation, not necessarily a physical opening or proof that either group has made no progress.
brief.boundaryZh: 差距擴大不等於其中一方一定下降，也不表示永遠不能縮小；需指出比較哪兩方、哪個指標及時間。
brief.misconceptionZh: 分清目前大差距與越來越大的差距；只有一次資料，通常不足以確定趨勢。
brief.outcomeZh: 能準確比較變化，也能就資料缺口提出有界線的查詢或後續安排。

sources.sentence: There is a widening gap in pay.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page156, table1, row3; unknown locators remain null.

listening.en: There was a widening gap in completed reading tasks: one group rose from eight to twelve, while the other rose from five to six. Both improved, but the difference grew, so we kept the two results separate in the report.
listening.zh: 完成閱讀任務的差距逐漸擴大：一組由八項增至十二項，另一組由五項增至六項。兩組都改善，但差額變大，所以報告分開保留兩項結果。
listening.promptZh: 哪個描述同時保留改善與差距的變化？

options.en: Both groups completed more, while the difference between them increased.
options.zh: 兩組完成得更多，但彼此差額增加。

options.en: The second group completed fewer tasks than it had before.
options.zh: 第二組完成的任務，比自己之前少。

options.en: The difference stayed at the same size because both groups improved.
options.zh: 因兩組都改善，所以差額維持相同。

options.en: Only the final figures were available, with no earlier measures to compare.
options.zh: 只有最後數字，沒有較早量度可比較。

listening.explanationZh: 八到十二、五到六都上升，但差額由三變六；兩者可以同時成立。

reply.promptEn: Why did you report the two groups separately rather than only say that both improved?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼分開報告兩組，而不只說都有改善？

options.en: There was a widening gap as the first group’s increase was larger.
options.zh: 第一組增加得更多，所以差距逐漸擴大。

options.en: The difference grew from three tasks to six, which the shared positive summary would hide.
options.zh: 差額由三項變六項，只說共同改善會隱藏這點。

options.en: Both rose, but the amounts of change were not the same.
options.zh: 兩組都上升，但變化幅度不同。

options.en: Separate figures preserved the trend between groups as well as each group’s progress.
options.zh: 分開數字，既保留每組進展，也保留兩組之間的趨勢。

reply.explanationZh: 四句各自說明分開數字的資訊價值，不把差距擴大誇成第二組已倒退。

scene.promptZh: 報告只列今年兩組的數字，沒有過往資料，作者想稱差距正在擴大。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: A present difference alone does not establish a widening gap without an earlier comparison.
options.zh: 只有目前差別，沒有較早比較，不能確定差距正在擴大。

options.en: The single comparison proves the difference has grown each year.
options.zh: 單次比較證明，差別每年都增加。

options.en: The report explicitly compares this year’s gap with several earlier years.
options.zh: 報告明確把今年差額與幾個較早年份比較。

scene.explanationZh: 有差別與差別變大是不同說法；趨勢需要時間比較，不能由一次數字補上。

contrast.promptZh: a widening gap最直接描述哪一項？

options.en: 差別隨時間變大。
其中一方必定正在倒退。
差別以後不可能縮小。

contrast.explanationZh: 差距擴大可在雙方都進步時發生，也沒有保證往後走向。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「差距變大，就寫第二組比以前差吧？」第二組其實由五項增至六項。哪句最好？

options.en: A widening gap does not mean the second group went backwards; it improved, while the first increased more.
options.zh: 差距擴大不表示第二組倒退；它有改善，只是第一組增加更多。

options.en: I had taken a larger gap to mean that the second group’s own result was lower than before.
options.zh: 我把差距變大，理解成第二組自己的結果比以前低。

options.en: I thought two increases must leave the distance between them unchanged.
options.zh: 我以為兩組都增加，彼此差額就必須不變。

dialogue.explanationZh: 兩組自己的結果與彼此差額可有不同變化；兩組都增加不保證差額固定，差額變大也不等於第二組下降。

speaking.en: Before calling it a widening gap, I want to know what was compared and whether the difference has changed over time.
speaking.zh: 稱它為逐漸擴大的差距前，我想知道比較的是甚麼，以及差別是否隨時間改變。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把趨勢與比較依據連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生連載故事出了多章，編輯在最近三次讀者討論中發現，追看已久的人越來越快理解人物關係，新加入者卻越來越難跟上缺少的背景。你想請作者加一小段回顧，先試給新讀者看，不判定他們閱讀能力差。用一至兩句英文寫實際請求。

examples.en: The recent discussions suggest a widening gap in familiarity between long-time and new readers, not proof that newcomers lack reading ability. Could we add a short recap of the relationships and ask new readers whether it supplies the missing context?
examples.zh: 最近討論顯示，長期與新讀者的熟悉程度差距在擴大，不是證明新讀者閱讀能力不足；我們可加一小段人物關係回顧，再問新讀者是否補上缺少的背景嗎？

examples.en: As the story continues, there seems to be a widening gap between the background regular readers know and what newcomers can follow. Please try a brief recap with new readers before the next chapter, rather than blame them for not having read the earlier instalments.
examples.zh: 故事繼續發展時，長期讀者知道的背景與新讀者能跟上的內容，似乎出現擴大的差距；下章前，請先讓新讀者試讀簡短回顧，不責怪他們沒看過早期篇章。

glossary.en: a short recap of the relationships

writing.selfCheckZh: 以連續討論的熟悉程度差異提出回顧及試讀請求，保留似乎與顯示的程度，不把背景缺口當成新讀者能力低的證據。

takeaways.en: The figures showed a widening gap between the two groups, even though both had completed more tasks than before.
takeaways.zh: 數字顯示兩組的差距擴大，即使兩組都比以前完成更多任務。

takeaways.en: She asked for earlier figures before describing the current difference as a widening gap.
takeaways.zh: 她先要求較早數字，才把目前差別描述為逐漸擴大的差距。
